events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, he would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur today. His music continues to resonate decades on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of rock legend Jimi Hendrix in 1970, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: A true guitar god, Jimi Hendrix, remembered today. His revolutionary sound changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Still sounds as fresh as ever! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released today in '69. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! An absolute icon of rock and new wave.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' by John Lennon was released today in 1975. Its message still resonates.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Cast your mind back to 2001! The original iPod dropped today, changing how we listened to music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: An absolute masterpiece! The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped today in '68. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering a Champion
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal album that redefined pop music. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released today in '65. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since his passing. His music and spirit live on.
